name: Iron Nightmare
look: a black robot Darkrai with a bell-shaped body, ball-tipped shoulder antennae, long clawed arms with red joint lights, a white helmet in a red hood and yellow lightning crackling over it
entry: A Pokémon resembling Darkrai, recorded in a report about a machine that appeared in a thunderstorm and left every sleeper nearby dreaming of static. Lightning arcs between its claws.
how: Wild: very rare in dark forests and old-growth pine taigas during thunderstorms.
